231:t_017:20.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Hey, you! Just because you've learned a little about songs, you can't butt in and say whatever you want!」

231:t_017:21.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「Whatever I want? You say that to me, the self-proclaimed biggest $$熱気バサラ$$ fan in the universe?」

231:t_018:3.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「$$シビル$$... Even after being reduced to this state, you still believe in $$熱気バサラ$$'s song...」

231:t_018:8.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「Then let me hear it!」

231:t_018:9.en:
$$バサラ$$
「$$シビル$$! You come too!!」

231:t_019:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「$$シビル$$'s here! Let's do that one for the first time in a while!」

231:t_019:2.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Here we go! Listen to my soooong!!」

231:t_021:2.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Did you hear that, Gepe-whatever! That's $$バサラ$$'s song!!」

231:t_021:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「Why is the Major the one acting all high and mighty about it!?」

231:t_021:4.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「Ohh... Ohhh!! $$スピリチア$$aaah!!」

231:t_021:5.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「It's coming... It's coming!!」

231:t_021:7.en:
$$ガビル$$
「It's welling up from the depths of my body! This is life-beauty!!」

231:t_022:0.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「$$熱気バサラ$$... You people may just be able to overcome the 120-million-year true end...」

231:t_022:2.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「We will lend a hand as well. Leave those fellows to us.」

231:t_022:3.en:
$$ガビル$$
「Until we meet again, $$ガムリン$$! Promise-beauty!」

231:t_023:1.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「Captain $$ガムリン$$, the enemy in front of us has to come first right now.」

231:t_023:3.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Yeah! I'm always gonna burn my heart out!!」

231:t_023:4.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Even $$ゲペルニッチ$$ knows about the crisis of the universe's collapse... The true collapse that comes once every 120 million years...」

231:t_023:5.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain! The $$プロトデビルン$$ ships are also fighting the $$サイデリアル$$ in the surrounding area!」

231:t_023:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「If we can secure their cooperation, hope will be born! We will win this battle no matter what!」

231:t_023:7.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Let's go, you guys! Listen to my soooong!!」

231:t_024:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Confirmed: all $$サイデリアル$$ and $$バジュラ$$ units have been shot down or have retreated.」

231:t_024:1.en:
$$ラム$$
「The $$プロトデビルン$$ ship and $$バトル７$$ are both safe. Both say they will rendezvous with us.」

231:t_024:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Amazing...! It's truly amazing, $$バサラ$$'s song!」

231:t_024:3.en:
$$ルカ$$
「He saved us when we were supposed to be sent off somewhere, and now he's even made contact with the $$プロトデビルン$$...」

231:t_024:4.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「If we can hear the truth about the true end from $$ゲペルニッチ$$ now, it'll be a big help.」

231:t_024:5.en:
$$カナリア$$
「The $$プロトデビルン$$ have lived tens of thousands of years, and they themselves came to this world because of the universe's collapse... We should hear some useful information.」

231:t_024:6.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Hey, $$シビル$$... Do you know what the true collapse that comes once every 120 million years is?」

231:t_024:7.en:
$$シビル$$
「$$シビル$$... like $$バサラ$$'s song!」

231:t_024:9.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「That's fine. We'll know everything soon.」

231:t_026:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Dimensional boundary line distortion confirmed! This is... a pattern completely different from anything observed so far!」

231:t_026:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, return! A $$時空震動|lc$$ is about to occur!!」

231:t_026:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
(It's beginning... No, is it the end...?)

231:t_028:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What is that thing...!? Its combat power is beyond anything we've seen from the $$アンゲロイ$$ so far!」

231:t_028:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「It's not just a variation...! It's something fundamentally different!」

231:t_028:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Search complete. No matching cases.」

231:t_028:4.en:
$$レド$$
「A type even the $$人類銀河同盟$$ has never made contact with?」

231:t_028:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Significant proposal. As another possibility, the units that made contact may have been annihilated.」

231:t_028:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「No... I can't dismiss Chamber's guess as wrong either...」

231:t_028:8.en:
$$シン$$
「After seeing this thing's strength with my own eyes, I can believe that too...」

231:t_028:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Can we... Can Earth beat something like this...?」

231:t_029:1.en:
$$カツ$$
「If guys like these get mass-produced...」

231:t_029:3.en:
$n
(That machine means more than that... That's what terrifies me...)

231:t_100:0.en:
$$アルト$$
($$ＹＦ－２９$$...! For now, I'll use your power to fight!)
